title: P02 T11 fail-closed source security/privacy and PR merge-gate preparation
summary: Added source-based independent security/privacy contract tests and strict Windows CI audit for final M02/M19 P02 preview. Reviews original Tauri CSP, main-readonly privilege allowlist, typed Rust IPC scope/version/bounds, local-only Help and user-initiated report clipboard, absence of arbitrary network/browser storage/dynamic HTML/script injection, and untrusted PR workflow read-only permissions. Negative tests reject forged privilege expansion, external fetch and false T11 DONE. Reviewed outstanding inline PR comments; current source and tests prove each obsolete finding addressed; six review threads now resolved. This does not certify Narrator, all product states, hardware performance SLA, independent merge approval or release. All prior source security, Governance and real Windows CI passed on ac8b8ed5 (#45307557723), including warm IPC 864/891/891ms and cold metadata 40136ms (within CI budget, production outlier not resolved). Added read-only actual public Wiki Chrome DOM verification with historical published SHA comparison and immutable Git source file readback, corrected canonical Help/Wiki publication wording without mutating remote pages or enabling native external navigation. Exact-head new verifier must pass. Public Chrome Wiki DOM and 16 option IDs/pinned source links passed on run 45309235364. Isolated the Wiki job from P01 desktop workflow after checkout-count contract rejected new job; kept original contract unchanged. Added live Microsoft-signed Narrator speech clipboard verification and first-observed metadata timing breakdown, plus corrected obsolete Help publication contract after real hosted browser proof. New runtime CI pending. Runtime Windows #45309772993 T10 native budget/NVDA/security passed, but Narrator failed genuine expected speech capture on Windows Server 2025 (ZYN-NAR-005). Corrected extended Insert key scancode, try Caps Lock, foreground PID and bounded clipboard/OS diagnostics. No requirement waived. Native FAQ screenshot #45311351448 failed ZYN-SCREEN-043 before Narrator; now reselect actual FAQ tab after glossary scroll and scroll named disclosure into view, preserve keyboard Enter and original visual acceptance gate. Real Narrator Preferences speech verified in exact artifact #14884851560; palette focus failed next. Added documented SR+3 pass-through with actual toolbar Invoke fallback and focused native input; no speech/keyboard acceptance relaxation. Actual second failed receipt #14884889067 verified real CapsLock Preferences speech; corrected successful modifier reuse, fresh root, named toolbar click and isolated pinned diagnostic artifact; fail closed against mixed-source acceptance. Actual Windows #45319452811 verified real palette navigation now passes but last spoken phrase mismatches both modifiers; synchronize Narrator cursor with system cursor using documented Narrator+left bracket, fresh focus and safe known-label diagnostics. Wait for real navigation readiness before isolated startup. Exact isolated receipt #14888546503 confirmed Narrator reads selected Overview active descendant, not input label. Added real keyboard empty-result/input-label check plus separate spoken exact search result and opened Help; four actual stages, stricter verifier, no product or merge approval. Bounded foreground reacquisition only with independent PID recheck. Actual exact-head Windows #45324467511 passed four Narrator speech stages, native security, visuals, NVDA and preview budgets. Canonical scope audit discovered omitted M26 and M23–M25 UI tasks; added T12/T13 and blockers #16/#17. Separated premerge-only state checks from reusable source and visual regression tests, repaired two warning sources and evidence action versions, retained inherited warning ledger #18; fresh CI required. T12 initial integrated read-only Change Center UI, navigation, local search and contextual Help implemented at source; no signed release data, no native privilege grants. Corrected stale v4 upload assertion after actual plan-alignment CI failure and bounded one startup relaunch before Narrator speech. Native T12 acceptance remains pending. Windows run 45583693785 passed the legacy NVDA and T10 checks but Narrator read the palette input instead of the exact Help result. Focus the actual Help list item with a real Tab before the spoken-result probe and verify Narrator teardown before the next speech probe. Added bounded Windows keyboard recovery for the M26 reset and system-center entry, native Changelog button activation recovery for the M26 NVDA probe, and graceful Narrator exit before forced cleanup. Whole-suite verification on the new commit is pending. The exact approved head passed all seven workflows and the protected merge SHA was independently verified on main.
migration_notes: No changes to SQLite state, disk data, Rust privileges, user network connectivity or user files. Source-only CI regression and documentation. Rollback by reverting test/gate/doc commit.
